newsitem.title: GERMANY: Opel says five-month sales slide in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Opel says five-month sales slide in Europe.

text.p: German carmaker Adam Opel AG, a unit of U.S. carmaker General Motors Corp, said on Thursday its sales in Germany from January to May this year fell to 235,000 units from 266,600 units and also reported a lower market share.
Opel said its market share in Germany fell to 15.5 percent from 16.7 percent in the 1997 five-month period compared with the 1996 five-month period.

The carmaker also said its share of the west European vehicle market also slipped during the period, falling to 11.8 percent from 12.6 percent in the year-ago period as new vehicle registrations fell to 690,000 units from 724,000 units.
